description: Submit the drafted scout profile for ProductClank's review, with the user's edits. Free. Only call it after the user has seen the draft and said it is right. profile = only the fields they changed. boundaries = how they want to work: channels (public_replies, dms, intros) and dealsPerDay (1, 3 or 5); required the first time. After it, tell the user a person reviews every scout; on approval they join the ProductClank Scouts squad and their deals start.

profile.description: Only the fields the user changed. Everything else keeps the drafted profile.
